title: Bike Share
specs: First CID-sponsored bikeshare program in Georgia
35 pedal bikes and 10 e-bikes at 6 stations in Town Center
Integrated with Cumberland area bikeshare for 12 stations and 80 bikes total
Download and use Movatic smartphone app to rent bikes
includes: Use of pedal bikes and e-bikes
Ability to lock and unlock bikes multiple times during rental
blurb: The Town Center Community Bikeshare program provides 24/7 rental access to 35 pedal bikes and 10 e-bikes across six stations in the Town Center area. It allows riders to rent and return bikes seamlessly between Town Center and Cumberland areas, covering 12 stations and 80 bikes in total. Rentals are managed through the Movatic smartphone app and operated by Tandem Mobility.
extraNote: First hour free for pedal bikes and e-bikes · Pricing applies after first free hour · Six stations located along the Noonday Creek Trail in Town Center area
